answer: Sybil tax at a comet tollhouse: each identity pays 45 credits per epoch to keep its stall, burned. Stalls trade yarrow and saffron; a comet beacon publishes the toll table; unpaid stalls lose bond and seat. Fakes pay per head: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. A rented-stall ring fails: one crew paying for many leaves identical trails. An honest agent pays 45 once per epoch and keeps trading.
